description: Connect your Wilfie account to check orders, inventory and business metrics in the workspaces you can access. Find sales orders and inspect their status, items and totals. Look up products and warehouses, and distinguish stock on hand, allocated stock and available quantities. Discover the analytics available in a workspace, then request summaries, trends and rankings using supported metrics and filters. Results preserve the workspace’s currency, timezone and metric definitions. This connection provides read-only access and follows your existing workspace permissions. A Wilfie account with access to a workspace is required.

defaultPrompt: Find a sales order in my workspace and show its status, items and total.
How much stock is on hand, allocated and available for a product at a warehouse?
What analytics are available in my workspace, and what do those metrics measure?
